value.rationale: An arXiv:2610.04305v1 Question 8.1 motivates determination of lower Betti numbers for the four-or-more-strand family K_{m+1,m+r-1}. K5,5 is the first balanced case with four particles, a natural canonical test case; the exact previously unforced values dim H2=528 and dim H3=1278 over F2 are substantive exact finite invariants useful as benchmarks for proposed general formulas, FI-module ranges, and integral-homology calculations. No claim of settling the general question is made.
